stage1_plan.missing_check: Missing authentication/authorization guard on admin-only JSP entry; a visitor can directly POST to admin/addnews2.jsp and execute the news INSERT without being challenged.
stage1_plan.insertion_location: At the top of the JSP scriptlet in admin/addnews2.jsp, immediately after `<%@ page language="java" import="java.sql.*" %>` and before `// add_res.jsp // form data`, any `request.getParameter` reads, or database operations.
stage1_plan.reused_project_semantics: Reuses the project’s existing admin guard context from admin/auth.jsp: the `drhlLoggedIn` session flag, the sentinel value `"true"`, and the denial style `response.sendRedirect("index.jsp"); return;`.
stage1_plan.reason: admin/addnews2.jsp is an admin-only standalone entry that performs a sensitive database INSERT. It currently has no access check, so an unauthenticated visitor can POST directly and modify data. The existing project guard in admin/auth.jsp checks the `drhlLoggedIn` session attribute for `"true"` and redirects unauthorized users to index.jsp. Inserting this exact guard at the start of the scriptlet blocks unauthorized visitors before parameter parsing or SQL execution while preserving intended admin access.

stage2_messages.content: Generate a minimal source-code access-control patch. Reuse project guard semantics exactly. Unauthorized requests must be blocked before sensitive operations. Do not refactor unrelated code. Return only JSON, no Markdown.

stage2_patch.explanation: Applied the existing admin guard from admin/auth.jsp to the top of the scriptlet in admin/addnews2.jsp. The guard checks the drhlLoggedIn session attribute for the value "true"; if absent or not true, it redirects to index.jsp and returns, blocking unauthorized visitors before any parameter parsing or database INSERT. Authorized admin users with drhlLoggedIn="true" pass through unchanged, preserving intended functionality.
